questions.solution_text:
Restriction: $x \neq 4$.
Multiply by $(x - 4)^2$:
$7(x - 4) \ge (x - 4)^2$
$(x - 4)(x - 4 - 7) \le 0$
$(x - 4)(x - 11) \le 0$
Critical values: $x = 4, 11$.
Since $x \neq 4$:
$4 < x \le 11$

Restriction: $x \neq -3$.
Multiply by $(x + 3)^2$:
$5(x + 3) < (x + 3)^2$
$(x + 3)^2 - 5(x + 3) > 0$
$(x + 3)(x - 2) > 0$
Critical values: $x = -3, 2$.
$x < -3$ or $x > 2$

questions.solution_text:
Restriction: $x \neq -2$.
Multiply by $(x + 2)^2$:
$(4x - 3)(x + 2) \le (x + 2)^2$
$(x + 2)[(4x - 3) - (x + 2)] \le 0$
$(x + 2)(3x - 5) \le 0$
Critical values: $x = -2, \dfrac{5}{3}$.
Since $x \neq -2$:
$-2 < x \le \dfrac{5}{3}$

questions.solution_text:
Restrictions: $x \neq 0, -5$.
Multiply by $x^2(x + 5)^2$:
$x(x + 5)^2 \le x^2(x + 5)$
$x(x + 5)[(x + 5) - x] \le 0$
$5x(x + 5) \le 0$
Critical values: $x = -5, 0$.
Since $x \neq -5$ and $x \neq 0$:
$-5 < x < 0$
